summary: Required arm and foot anatomy is within the close-up frames; capture coverage is valid. The model substantially misses the approved target, and the supplied deterministic report identifies eight reversed claws.

findings.message: Supplied technical report: all six front claws have direction dot -0.98; both rear claws have direction dot -0.94. These are reported deterministic failures, not measurements independently derived from screenshots.
findings.recommendation: Correct all eight claw directions and rerun the deterministic checks.

findings.message: Smooth rounded limb segments, a rectangular chest panel, compressed neck, blunt face, and straight segmented tail differ substantially from the target's integrated armored anatomy, elongated head, exposed neck, and curved tail.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the major anatomical masses and silhouette against the approved target before refining details.

findings.message: Broad overlapping brow and muzzle plates obscure the eye region. The rounded jaw and block-like muzzle do not form the target's tapered reptilian face; eye and vent orientation cannot be verified because these features are not distinguishable.
findings.recommendation: Separate readable eyes and vents, taper the muzzle, and integrate the crown and jaw into a coherent head.

findings.message: Each foot shows three front claw positions, but the highlighted ends read as broad angular caps rather than pointed talons. Rear claw geometry is partly concealed by the ankle/heel volume; this is occlusion, not frame cropping.
findings.recommendation: Expose and taper every claw, with three projecting forward and one clearly projecting backward on each foot.

findings.message: The dorsal forms read as overlapping flat slabs with simple wedge profiles. Seven distinct shattered storm shields are not clearly readable, and the target's broad fractured outlines are absent.
findings.recommendation: Create seven individually readable shields with irregular fractured silhouettes and visible branching fissures.

findings.message: The supplied height/depth ratio is 1.2664, below its 1.35 threshold. Visually, the creature nevertheless stands upright without arm support.
findings.recommendation: Review body and tail proportions against the target and rerun the ratio check.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, armor treatment, proportions, and tail silhouette substantially diverge from the approved target.
Overlapping plates obscure the eyes and vents; their orientation cannot be verified. The muzzle and jaw read as disconnected blunt forms.
Both close-ups include shoulder attachment, upper arm, lower arm, and complete hand. Below the shoulder attachment, the arms remain externally readable without visibly passing through the torso.

All six front claw positions and both rear claw regions were inspected. Front ends appear cap-like, rear claws are partly buried or occluded, and the supplied deterministic report flags all eight directions.
Front and side views show an upright torso carried by the legs, with hands hanging freely.
A bipedal creature with dorsal armor and a tail is recognizable, but the target's distinctive head, neck, shield spread, and integrated muscular silhouette are not preserved.
Seven distinct fractured shields cannot be verified; the visible forms read as simple overlapping slabs and wedges.
Side views show bent leg chains with raised heel transitions; the legs are substantially more massive than the short free-hanging arms and visibly bear the body.
